faq.q: How does the purchase process work?
faq.a: Purchases can be completed through Atom.com's escrow service, which handles payment and domain transfer. Alternatively, contact Midjump to arrange a direct transaction through Escrow.com, including multi-domain acquisitions or custom arrangements.
Yes, each domain includes custom logo concepts, available to the buyer upon request.
